findings.statement: v2 shows an empty wok receiving oil/clear liquid, then diced garlic and dark spices being added and stirred.
v1 begins with aromatics already sizzling in oil, then raw ground meat is added, broken apart, dark sauce and chili paste are added, and the meat is stirred to coat.
The v2 empty-wok oil/aromatics state precedes the v1 raw-meat addition state because v1 starts with sizzling aromatics already in the wok.
v3 shows dried red chilies placed into a clean stainless pot and cut, and shows tofu being sliced into cubes.
v4 shows a meat/aromatics base simmering, then dried red chilies poured into bubbling sauce, then tofu cubes added and simmering in dark red sauce.
v3's cutting of chilies and tofu provides ingredient states that v4 later adds to the sauce, grounding v3 before v4.
v1's raw-meat and sauce/paste stage grounds v4's meat-base stage as a later simmering step before chilies and tofu are added.
The latest observed wok state in the answer evidence map is tofu cubes simmering in dark red sauce in v4.
